an3.55:1.1: atha kho jāṇussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.55:1.2: ‘sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānanti’ bho gotama vuccati.
an3.55:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ehipassikaṃ opanayikaṃ paccattaṃ veditabbaṃ viññūhīti?
an3.55:2.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti. cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:2.2: rāge pahīṇe nevattavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:2.3: evaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti.
an3.55:3.2: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:3.3: mohe pahīṇe nevattavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:3.4: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti.
an3.55:4.1: yato ca kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇa anavasesaṃ rāgakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, anavasesaṃ dosakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, anavasesaṃ mohakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.55:4.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ehipassikaṃ opanayikaṃ paccattaṃ veditabbaṃ viññūhīti.
an3.55:5.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
